labeled_by: source-first; implementation-aware, no map output viewed
description: Per-category source-first holdout. Exact precision is asserted only for fully enumerated deployable records evidenced by the four oracle files; interface, component, capability, edge, and coverage facts are reported separately as targeted recall or uncertainty.

components.name: web
components.why: services/web/requirements.txt:1-4 is the dependency manifest. docker-compose.yml:5 sets the web build context to ./services/web, and services/web/project/__init__.py:13 declares the application package Flask object. Label name follows the source directory used as the build/component root; no distribution name is declared.

deployables.name: web
deployables.why: docker-compose.yml:4-14 declares service web with build context ./services/web and depends_on db.

deployables.name: db
deployables.why: docker-compose.yml:15-22 declares service db with image postgres:13.

deployables.name: web
deployables.why: services/web/Dockerfile:1,8,15,20,23 declares a Python container build with application files copied into its image and an entrypoint.

interfaces.name: app
interfaces.why: services/web/project/__init__.py:13 declares module-level app = Flask(__name__). Routes in lines 29-55 are implementation details of this one Flask application; the documented 1.0 vocabulary does not emit one interface per route.
docker-compose.yml:9-10 maps host port 5001 to container port 5000. The labeled interface is the declared container port 5000.

capabilities.why: services/web/requirements.txt:4 declares psycopg2-binary; docker-compose.yml:15-22 declares the matching PostgreSQL 13 service.
services/web/project/__init__.py:9,15 imports and instantiates Flask-SQLAlchemy; requirements.txt:2 declares Flask-SQLAlchemy 3.0.3.

edges.why: docker-compose.yml:4-5 declares web service build context ./services/web, which is the Python component root.
docker-compose.yml:13-14 directly declares web depends_on db.
services/web/requirements.txt:4 declares psycopg2-binary for the PostgreSQL service declared in docker-compose.yml:15-22.
services/web/project/__init__.py:9,15 imports and instantiates Flask-SQLAlchemy; requirements.txt:2 declares it.
docker-compose.yml:9-10 declares the web service port mapping to container port 5000.

components.why: This exact score is limited to four oracle files; the entire repository component population and component naming conventions are not independently established.

deployables.why: The exact oracle includes the development Compose file and web Dockerfile. Production Compose, Nginx, and the other Dockerfiles are supporting recall targets, not part of exact precision scope.

interfaces.why: The exact oracle includes the Flask application and dev Compose port. Production Compose and Nginx interface declarations are outside the exact oracle set. The Compose command may also be interpreted as a Python entrypoint, so the interface category is not used for exact precision.

capabilities.why: The source establishes PostgreSQL and ORM declarations, but this file does not claim the complete supported capability population for the application or repository.

edges.why: Direct build and depends_on declarations are labeled; complete edge population across the repository is not established.

evaluation_scope.interfaces: targeted_recall_only; no exact precision denominator because docker-compose.yml also declares a Python command whose interface classification is ambiguous from the documented contract
evaluation_scope.coverage: not_scored_as_accuracy; statuses above describe full-repository uncertainty separately from evaluation_scope

targeted_recall.fact: Production Compose adds service web, service db, and service nginx; nginx is built from ./services/nginx.
Production Compose exposes web container port 5000 and maps nginx host port 1337 to container port 80.
Production Compose declares web depends_on db and nginx depends_on web.
Production web image uses Dockerfile.prod; Nginx image has its own Dockerfile.

notes: Exact precision is valid only for deployables and interfaces sourced from oracle_files. The verifier may show other category scores, but components/capabilities/edges are targeted recall only and must not be presented as exact precision.
The source declaration docker-compose.yml:9-10 is host:container (5001:5000); the interface label uses container port 5000, not host port 5001.
The development and production Compose files are distinct. Production service facts are retained in targeted_recall and supporting_files, outside the exact oracle denominator.
The map coverage statuses are not evidence evaluation scope. Unknown coverage for unreviewed populations is intentional.

The Compose command (docker-compose.yml:6) is an explicit Python invocation. Whether it yields an additional Python-entrypoint interface is not pinned down by the source contract; therefore interfaces are targeted recall only despite the explicit Flask object and port facts.
